verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents AI agents that auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate complex cases to humans. It also documents manual case decisions and a case audit trail. Nothing in the pack shows a reviewer inspecting an AI auto-remediation decision, overriding it, or the AI's original evidence and rationale being preserved. Escalation and manual case decisioning are adjacent features, not an override of an automated decision.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can inspect and override an automated remediation decision while preserving its original evidence and rationale
